OlmoEarth v1.3: State-of-the-art embeddings for the whole planet Foundation models and global embeddings are expensive to produce, and to make sure everyone is able to access the benefits, we've computed these embeddings for the entire planet and shared them with the community on Source Cooperative. The OlmoEarth Embeddings Explorer is an interactive analysis tool built from the embeddings themselves, rendered as a false-color map of the planet. This release includes the OlmoEarth v1.3 Base model, the precomputed global embeddings, the OlmoEarth Embeddings Explorer, and the technical report. Hugging Face Blog 29 分钟前

NVIDIA Unveils Minerva to Bring End-to-End Observability for AI Factories Launched today, NVIDIA Minerva is an AIOps platform built to help teams find problems earlier and keep AI factories productive. It brings together telemetry from infrastructure and AI workloads, then applies purpose-built AI models to turn that data into timely, actionable insight. AI factories are among the most complex operations in the world, with vast numbers of GPUs working across high-speed networks to train models and serve AI applications. NVIDIA Blog 1 小时前

讯飞星火 X2.6 端云一体大模型发布，首次基于全国产算力突破代码与智能体能力 董事长刘庆峰在发布会上点明，目前做大模型的公司里，只有星火一家是纯粹用全国产算力训练的，其余几乎都跑在英伟达的卡上，而科大讯飞模型的尺寸还是其中最小的。星火 X2.6-4B 开源端侧大模型同步发布，首次让端侧模型在智能体能力上实现阶跃，各项跑分相比 X2.5-4B 明显抬升。X2.6-4B 端侧模型在代码、智能体、长文本和多语言能力上大幅提升，新增三档推理模式，在自研推理框架下的效率比 ollama 更好，推理定价限时免费。 AIBase 8 小时前

Ensemble forecasting with IBM Granite time-series models Start with the Probabilistic Ensemble (uniform probability pooling), compare the adaptive Inter Quartile Range (IQR) Ensemble, and extend the same interface with compatible forecasters. Ensemble forecasts explore a range of possible outcomes, and systems such as the North American Multi-Model Ensemble combine different models for seasonal prediction. Time-series forecasting benefits in a similar way: complementary models offer different views of what comes next, and an ensemble merges those views into one forecast. Hugging Face Blog 8 小时前

英伟达升级 Isaac 通用机器人平台并发布 Agile ONE SN 人形样机 英伟达近日宣布对其开源机器人开发平台 NVIDIA Isaac 进行重大扩容，正式推出全新人形机器人参考样机、配套数据集与运行时，并对机器人学习框架进行全面升级，标志着物理 AI 正加速向核心产业落地。思灵机器人同步发布了全栈人形机器人参考样机 Agile ONE SN，该样机预装 NVIDIA Isaac GR00T 并搭载 NVIDIA Jetson Thor 边缘 AI 平台，拥有 1.4 米身高、40 千克体重、31 个自由度及单臂 3 千克最大负载，配备 20 自由度的 WUJI Hand2 五指灵巧手，板载算力达 2070TFLOPS 并具备 128GB 统一内存，预计将于 2027 年初正式上市。NVIDIA Isaac OS 与全栈安全平台 NVIDIA Halos 共同打通了实时调度与安全合规流程。 AIBase 8 小时前

NVIDIA Cosmos Opens New Tools to Train, Evaluate and Deploy World Models To help developers rapidly build world models, which help physical AI systems understand and simulate the real world, NVIDIA has expanded the Cosmos platform with new training tools, simulation checkpoints and Cosmos Data Factory blueprints. Ranking top five on six different open models leaderboards, the NVIDIA Cosmos platform gives world model builders the frontier open models — as well as data, training and optimization tools and recipes — to scale training data, adapt models, test behavior and optimize for performance before deployment. Developers can use Cosmos Data Factory to generate training datasets, Cosmos Framework to train and adapt world models, then deploy supported Cosmos models through NIM microservices. NVIDIA Blog 11 小时前

NVIDIA Open Models Power a New Wave of European Public Sector Projects NVIDIA partners and European governments are teaming to bring advanced models to boost the efficiency of public administration while retaining control of data and infrastructure. To support local development, the Sovereign Open Source Foundation Models research initiative (Soofi) is developing a family of AI models for German industry and the public sector. In an effort to support public sector organizations in integrating agentic AI in Europe and beyond, NVIDIA Open Models Codefest brings together startups, software providers and labs across the region to turn open models into locally controlled solutions for public sector challenges, including medical reasoning, AI tutoring and model governance. NVIDIA Blog 11 小时前
